title: RAG vs Fine-Tuning for Business AI
verdict: Start with RAG for answering from company knowledge. Consider fine-tuning only after RAG and good prompts are in place and you have hundreds of high-quality examples of the exact behaviour you want.
seoTitle: RAG vs Fine-Tuning: Which Does Your AI App Need
seoDescription: RAG or fine-tuning for a business AI application: keeping answers current, accuracy, cost, data needs and why most company chatbots start with RAG.
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation gives an LLM the relevant passages from your documents at question time, so answers reflect current company knowledge. Fine-tuning trains a model further on examples, changing its style or behaviour. Most business assistants start with RAG; fine-tuning helps for consistent formats or specialised tasks at scale.

dataPoints.label: Best for
dataPoints.value: RAG: answering from documents that change. Fine-tuning: consistent style, format or narrow tasks

dataPoints.label: Keeping current
dataPoints.value: RAG updates when documents change; fine-tuning needs retraining

dataPoints.label: Data needed
dataPoints.value: RAG: your documents. Fine-tuning: many labelled examples

dataPoints.label: Traceability
dataPoints.value: RAG can show source passages; fine-tuned answers cannot cite sources

dataPoints.label: Cost
dataPoints.value: RAG: storage and retrieval. Fine-tuning: training runs plus hosting

body:
## They combine well

Some systems use RAG for knowledge and a fine-tuned model for output format. But most SMEs get what they need from RAG, good prompts and testing.

See [RAG](/glossary/rag), [fine-tuning](/glossary/fine-tuning), [vector databases](/glossary/vector-database) and [RAG or fine-tuning](/blog/rag-or-fine-tuning-choosing-the-right-approach-for-your-business-data).

Prices and features change often; check current details before deciding.

faqs.a: No. Grounding answers in retrieved sources and testing does more to reduce invented answers.

faqs.q: How many documents can RAG handle?
faqs.a: From a handful to millions, depending on design.
